acceptance_predicates.description: Development install clones and builds the selected ASB-TUI source head in a bounded temporary root rather than copying the running executable.
Published launcher provenance records exact repository, commit, tree, toolchain, and channel identities.
Failed clone, build, quota, or publication leaves no partial install and cleans temporary resources.
dev defaults correctly while stable, nightly, and experimental remain explicit typed channels without fallback.
Development installation never blocks solely on missing authentication, signatures, or key-management services.

definition_of_done: Implementation is merged on protected TUI main.
Independent review, hosted checks, and paired fresh-user qualification pass.

outputs.description: Atomic channel-aware clone/build installer with exact provenance.

gates.description: Bounded clone/build and cleanup tests pass.
Fresh install and rerun prove exact provenance.
Independent review and hosted checks are green.
